title: B. Noisy partial barge-in: the correction is clipped by a dropped pan
story: Same misrecognised call. The user shouts 'No, wait!' but drops a pan, so the recogniser only gets '…imer'. A system that only stops the call and goes silent leaves the user unsure whether it stopped, and forced to start again.

expect.said: Call to Mom cancelled before it connected. Did you want a timer?
